readings: For each account, average its transaction amounts (`trans.amount`), and assign the account to the region (`district.A3`) of its branch district (`account.district_id`). For each region, average those per-account averages to get the region's figure. For the regions whose figure is above the average across all regions, show each region, its figure, how much it exceeds the all-region average, and its figure divided by the average figure across all regions. Don't round anything.
queries:
WITH acc AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS acc_avg
  FROM trans t
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
reg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(acc_avg) AS figure
  FROM acc
  GROUP BY region
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(figure) AS overall_avg FROM reg
)
SELECT reg.region,
       reg.figure,
       reg.figure - overall.overall_avg AS excess,
       reg.figure / overall.overall_avg AS ratio
FROM reg, overall
WHERE reg.figure > overall.overall_avg
